truthTables.name: Partner Onboarding Legal & Integrity Truth Table
truthTables.description: Exhaustive truth table ensuring zero unverified, fraudulent, or non-compliant commercial partners enter production.

conditions.name: c1_entityRegistered
conditions.description: Legal entity and corporate jurisdiction verified

conditions.name: c2_insuranceRegulatedIfApplicable
conditions.description: Insurance underwriter has valid license and AM Best rating >= A

conditions.name: c3_trackingHttpsSecure
conditions.description: Tracking template uses HTTPS and valid token syntax

conditions.name: c4_editorialTested
conditions.description: Product/service physically reviewed or verified by editorial staff

actions.name: a2_tagRequiresManualAudit
actions.description: Flag for human security officer review

actions.name: a3_hardReject
actions.description: Reject intake and log security audit notice

truthTables.name: OFAC & International Sanctions Geofence Truth Table
truthTables.description: Guarantees absolute compliance with international sanctions laws by disallowing commercial transactions in embargoed jurisdictions.

conditions.name: c1_destinationSanctioned
conditions.description: Country is listed under OFAC/UN embargo (e.g. Syria, North Korea, Iran)

conditions.name: c2_isCommercialPayoutOffer
conditions.description: Offer involves monetary affiliate payout or commercial fee

conditions.name: c3_isFirstPartyPublicSafety
conditions.description: Offer is free emergency consular or public health information

actions.name: a1_renderOffer
actions.description: Permit display on traveler listings page

actions.name: a2_suppressCommercialLinks
actions.description: Strip affiliate links and tracking tokens

actions.name: a3_displayEmbassyWarningOnly
actions.description: Render life-safety consular advisory banner only

truthTables.name: Offer Category Collision & Exclusivity Truth Table
truthTables.description: Resolves multi-offer rendering when two competing partners target the exact same slot.

conditions.name: c1_multipleEligibleInSameSlot
conditions.description: Two or more offers qualify for the single hero banner

conditions.name: c2_exclusiveSponsorAgreementActive
conditions.description: One partner holds category exclusivity contract

conditions.name: c3_safetyScoresIdentical
conditions.description: Difference in editorial safety score is <= 3 points

actions.name: a2_serveHighestSafetyScore
actions.description: Display offer with superior safety score

actions.name: a3_renderSideBySideComparison
actions.description: Split hero into dual comparison drawer
